features: Enhanced Audio Experience: Immerse yourself in the world of music with the Conch Theta C wired earphones. Experience powerful audio with its 14.2mm speaker drivers, delivering rich, crystal-clear audio.

Widely Compatible: Connect effortlessly to your favourite devices with the convenient Type C audio jack, making it easy to use these wired headphones with various smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Type C compatible devices.

Unique Design: These type c earphones feature Unique design that provide better sound quality and are incredibly comfortable to wear. No more discomfort, enjoy hours of uninterrupted listening pleasure.

Convenient In-line Controls and Microphone: With in-line controls and a built-in microphone, these wired earphones with mic allow you to easily adjust volume, skip tracks, and take calls without reaching for your phone.
TPE Anti-tangle Wire: Say goodbye to frustrating knots and tangles with the 1.2m TPE anti-tangle wire. Simply plug in the c type earphones, wired to your device to enjoy hassle-free listening.

Note: If you encounter connectivity issues with your mobile phone, please open your device settings. Search for 'OTG' and enable the 'OTG Connection' option. If you experience persistent connection problems, contact our Customer Support for additional assistance.
No More Knots: Experience frustration-free listening with our anti-tangle TPE wire, designed to keep your Conch Theta A wired earphones knot-free and ready to go!

Wide Compatibility: These earphones, wired with a 3.5mm AUX jack, ensure high compatibility with a wide range of devices such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, and more.

Immersive Sound: Get ready to be blown away by the powerful audio delivered by the 14.2mm drivers in our 3.5mm earphones. Whether you're listening to your favourite music or enjoying a podcast, every beat and note will come alive!
Hands-Free Convenience: Stay connected and in control with the built-in microphone and controls. Easily switch between calls and music without reaching for your device.

Sweatproof and Durable: Built to withstand your active lifestyle, the wired earphones with mic have water resistant material, making them sweat proof and perfect for workouts, outdoor activities, or even rainy days.
